lines.t: Real-world assets on Ethereum, explained.
There are three ways to tokenize an asset.
One: the token is the asset itself, like BlackRock's BUIDL fund, whose shares are tokens on Ethereum.
lines.say: One: the token is the asset itself, like BlackRock's Build fund, whose shares are tokens on Ethereum.

lines.t: Two: a custodian holds the real share, and the token is a claim on it, like Coinbase's stocks on Base.
Three: the token just tracks the price.
Robinhood's stock tokens are a debt security: backed one to one, but with no rights in the company.
Why bother?
Settlement in seconds, not days.
Markets that never close.
Fractions of a share.
And a token any app can plug into.
Today, about $37 billion of real-world assets are on-chain, roughly three times more than a year ago.
lines.say: Today, about thirty-seven billion dollars of real-world assets are on-chain, roughly three times more than a year ago.

lines.t: And almost half of it sits on Ethereum.
The big banks see trillions ahead:
McKinsey up to $4 trillion by 2030, Citi $5.5 trillion, and Standard Chartered $30 trillion by 2034.
lines.say: McKinsey up to four trillion by 2030, Citi five and a half, and Standard Chartered thirty trillion by 2034.

lines.t: On-chain, a stock becomes a building block.
You can borrow dollars against tokenized Nvidia on Morpho.
On Robinhood Chain, meme coins even trade against stock tokens, and memes once made up almost 80% of its DEX volume.
lines.say: On Robinhood Chain, meme coins even trade against stock tokens, and memes once made up almost eighty percent of its dex volume.

lines.t: Smart contracts rebalance whole portfolios, and AI agents are starting to trade for you.
lines.say: Smart contracts rebalance whole portfolios, and A.I. agents are starting to trade for you.

lines.t: The catch: tokenizing is a legal marathon, not a coding job.
It takes a legal wrapper, a prospectus, licences, a custodian, and KYC country by country.
lines.say: It takes a legal wrapper, a prospectus, licences, a custodian, and K.Y.C. country by country.

lines.t: Dinari spent about a year with regulators before selling to Americans.
On September 17, the SEC opened a five-year Innovation Exemption for on-chain stock trading.
lines.say: On September seventeenth, the S.E.C. opened a five-year Innovation Exemption for on-chain stock trading.

lines.t: But only tokens with real shareholder rights qualify, and companies can veto third-party tokens of their stock.
Real-share models like Coinbase's win. Wrappers like Robinhood's don't qualify.
lines.say: Real-share models like Coinbase's win. [[slnc 150]] Wrappers like Robinhood's don't qualify.

lines.t: Same assets. New rails.
That's RWA on Ethereum.
lines.say: That's, R. W. A. on Ethereum.
